posts.name: Rabk
posts.cooked:
Mr. Fixer vs. Plague Rat is one of my favorite matchups in the entire game. So many fun possibilities.

Eventually I'll sit down and do a full write-up on the time I saw Fixer walk into a Fixed Point with the Rat and come back out prepared to deal 380+ damage to all non-hero targets in a single round (plus another 40(?) or so to single targets on top of that). The old martial artist was proud, to be sure, but Anthony Drake claims to this day that it was his own finest moment.

posts.cooked:
PLAGUE RAT - The second hero gets the cheese - ROUND 1

Plague Rat (85) [Plaguebearer] (+2 damage dealt)
- Plague Locus (13)

Start of Turn:
(does not flip)

Play: Ravage
 Plague Rat deals 4 toxic damage to Nightmist (23), Mister Fixer (24), and Rook City Wraith (23)
 Plague Rat deals 5 toxic damage to Chrono-Ranger (23)
 Four heroes are INFECTED

End of Turn:
Plague Rat deals 3 irreducible melee damage to Nightmist (20), Mister Fixer (21), Absolute Zero (26) and Rook City Wraith (20)
Plague Rat deals 4 irreducible melee damage to Chrono-Ranger (19)

Number of Infected Heroes: 4
========================
Effects:
- Whenever a card named Infection is destroyed Plague Rat deals each hero target 5 toxic damage
- Increase damage dealt by Plague Rat and by infected heroes by 1 (adv Plague Rat)
- Increase damage dealt by Plague Rat and all infected heroes by 1 (Plaguebearer)

(Start of Turn)
- If all active heroes are infected, flip Plague Rat's villain character cards (Plaguebearer)
- Infected heroes deal themselves 1 irreducible toxic damage (Infection)

(End of Turn)
- Plague Rat deals each hero target 1 irreducible melee damage (Plaguebearer)
- Plague Rat regains X HP, where X = the number of infected heroes (Plague Locus)

==========
Plague Rat (85) [Plaguebearer]

Ravage
